snippet: Lazio has struck an agreement with Polymarket, which has become the club’s new main sponsor at least until June 2028. The Biancocelesti have been without a jersey sponsor since the expiry of their two-year collaboration with Binance at the end of the 2022/23 campaign, thus missing out on the opportunity to increase their revenues.
title: Official: Lazio Announce Polymarket as New Main Sponsor - The Figures Revealed

snippet: AC Milan have reportedly made an important breakthrough in their attempts to recruit Lazio centre-back Mario Gila. The 25-year-old is considered among the finest defenders in Italian football, with some identifying him as the ultimate best in the Italian top flight.
title: AC Milan on the Cusp of Reaching an Agreement for Lazio Defender

snippet: Jack Harrison has dropped a strong hint about his desire to stay at Fiorentina beyond his current loan spell, telling reporters after the win over Lazio that any player would be happy to represent the club, while stopping short of confirming a permanent deal is imminent.
title: Harrison: ‘Anyone would be happy to play at Fiorentina’ as permanent move from Leeds possible
